Study in Prague with Hudson Valley University!
This summer, immerse yourself in one of Europe’s most captivating
cities through Hudson Valley University’s Summer Semester in
Prague. No Czech language skills are required—courses in history,
art, and cultural studies are taught in English by experienced faculty.
Each course integrates lectures with fieldwork for a dynamic
learning experience. Beyond the classroom, explore Prague’s
cultural landmarks and intellectual heritage. Stand beneath the
intricate Astronomical Clock in Old Town Square, walk across the
historic Charles Bridge, and visit the imposing Prague Castle, a
symbol of centuries of political and artistic evolution. Discover the
Jewish Quarter, home to profound narratives of resilience, and
experience the city’s café culture, long associated with literary and
philosophical discourse.
Program Highlights:
• Academic credit and cultural excursions
• Affordable housing and financial-aid options
• Guided weekend trips across Central Europe
Apply now—limited spaces available!
